title: Best robot vacuum deal: Omni C20 self-emptying combo is $170 off
excerpt: Retire from mop duty, effective immediately.
content_html:
SAVE $170: As of Aug. 10, the Eufy Omni C20 robot vacuum and mop combo is down to $379.99 at Amazon, from $549.99 — a 31% discount.

Credit: Eufy Omni C20 Robot Vacuum and Mop Combo

$379.99 at Amazon
$549.99 Save $170

The Eufy Omni C20 robot vacuum and mop combo is down to $379.99 at Amazon, a 31% cut off its $549.99 list price. That's $170 in savings on a vacuum that mops, empties itself, and cleans its own mop pads.

The base station empties the dustbin on its own, and it washes and dries the mop pads with warm air after every run, so you're not touching a dirty mop pad or dumping a bin every few days. Eufy says you can go up to 60 days between manual empties, depending on your household.

It vacuums and mops in the same pass instead of two separate cleanings. The mop pads spin and press down with force to scrub off dried spills on hardwood or tile, and they lift up automatically when they hit carpet, so your rugs don't get soaked. If a spot needs extra attention, the app lets you send it back over that area for a second pass.

Suction goes up to 7,000 Pa and adjusts automatically based on how dirty the surface is. Pet owners get a useful extra here: a comb flips down mid-clean to loosen hair wrapped around the roller brush, so you're not cutting tangled fur out of it yourself.

Mashable Deals

At just over 3 inches tall, it slides under couches, beds, and low cabinets that trip up bulkier robot vacuums. It runs about two hours on a charge, and if it doesn't finish before the battery dies, it heads back to the base to recharge and picks up where it left off.

Consider your floors handled. Grab the Eufy Omni C20 at Amazon before the price bounces back.

content_html_zh:
节省 170 美元：截至 8 月 10 日，Eufy Omni C20 机器人吸尘器和拖把组合在亚马逊上从 549.99 美元降至 379.99 美元，折扣 31%。

图片来源：Eufy Omni C20 扫地机器人和拖把组合

亚马逊 379.99 美元 549.99 美元 节省 170 美元

Eufy Omni C20 机器人吸尘器和拖把组合在亚马逊上降至 379.99 美元，比其 549.99 美元的标价降低了 31%。 购买一台能够拖地、自动清空并清洁拖把垫的吸尘器，可节省 170 美元。

基站会自行清空垃圾箱，每次运行后都会用暖风清洗并烘干拖把垫，这样您就不会每隔几天就触摸脏拖把垫或倒垃圾箱。 Eufy 表示，手动清空间隔时间最长可达 60 天，具体取决于您的家庭。

它可以同时进行吸尘和拖地操作，而不是两次单独的清洁。 拖把垫旋转并用力向下压，擦掉硬木或瓷砖上干燥的溢出物，当它们碰到地毯时它们会自动升起，这样你的地毯就不会被浸湿。 如果某个地点需要额外注意，该应用程序可以让您将其发送回该区域进行第二次检查。

吸力高达 7,000 Pa，并根据表面的脏程度自动调节。 宠物主人在这里可以获得一个有用的额外功能：梳子在清洁过程中向下翻转，以松开缠绕在滚刷上的毛发，这样您就不必自己剪掉缠结的毛发。

它的高度仅超过 3 英寸，可以滑到沙发、床和矮柜下面，从而绊倒笨重的机器人吸尘器。 它一次充电可以运行大约两个小时，如果在电池耗尽之前没有完成，它会返回底座充电并从上次停止的地方继续充电。
